extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners building or evaluating patent text embeddings (NLP/IR researchers, ML engineers working on patent retrieval and analysis)
extracted.subtask_description: Designing, training, and evaluating embedding models for patent text via a comprehensive benchmark spanning retrieval, classification, paraphrase, and clustering tasks, with domain-aware dataset construction and multi-task model training. Includes guidance on dataset scale, splits, negatives, model sizes, context length, validation metrics, and ablations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive multi-task benchmark coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: PatenTEB is a comprehensive benchmark comprising 15 tasks across retrieval, classification, paraphrase, and clustering, with 2.06 million examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benchmark should cover multiple task families (retrieval, classification, paraphrase, clustering) and be large-scale (millions of examples) to reflect diverse patent-specific challenges and enable robust training and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domain-stratified dataset splits
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dataset splits should be stratified by domain to prevent leakage across domains and to ensure evaluations reflect domain-specific generalization rather than domain-mixing artefacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domain-specific hard negative mining
rubrics_metrics.description: PatenTEB uses domain specific hard negative mining.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hard negatives for retrieval tasks should be mined within the patent domain (domain-aware negatives) to produce challenging, realistic retrieval scenarios rather than relying on generic or randomly sampled negatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asymmetric fragment-to-document matching coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Systematic coverage of asymmetric fragment-to-document matching scenarios absent from general embedding benchmarks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include fragment-to-document and other asymmetric matching scenarios unique to patents (e.g., short claim fragments vs full documents) because general embedding benchmarks often omit these, yet they are central to prior-art search and patent IR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for long context lengths
rubrics_metrics.description: patembed models support context lengths up to 4096 tokens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Models and input pipelines should handle long patent documents/sections (thousands of tokens) to capture relevant information in claims/specifications; benchmarked models should demonstrate capability at extended context lengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model family scale and architectural variants
rubrics_metrics.description: The patembed model family spans 67M to 344M parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate multiple model sizes (small to large) to study scaling effects; report model capacity and how it interacts with benchmark performance and generalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-task training as a core modeling approach
rubrics_metrics.description: patembed models are developed through multi-task training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Train embedding models jointly across multiple related tasks to improve external generalization; recognize potential small drops on some internal benchmark metrics as a tradeoff for better out-of-distribution performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contrastive learning for embeddings
rubrics_metrics.description: Contrastive learning is listed among the methodologies (keywords include 'contrastive learning').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use contrastive objectives where appropriate to learn discriminative sentence/document embeddings, especially for retrieval-centric tasks; combine with multi-task losses when beneficial.

rubrics_metrics.name: External validation on established benchmarks using cluster/retrieval metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: External validation shows patembed-base achieves state-of-the-art on MTEB BigPatentClustering.v2 (0.494 V-measure vs. 0.445 previous best) and patembed-large achieves 0.377 NDCG@100 on DAPFAM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validate models on external, community benchmarks (e.g., MTEB BigPatentClustering.v2, DAPFAM) and report standard clustering and retrieval metrics (V-measure, NDCG@K) to demonstrate real-world generalization beyond the internal benchmark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ablation studies to quantify training/component effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Systematic ablations reveal that multi-task training improves external generalization despite minor benchmark costs, and that domain-pretrained initialization provides consistent advantages across task families.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform thorough ablations (e.g., with/without multi-task training, with/without domain pretraining) to quantify tradeoffs and isolate the contributions of design choices; explicitly report where multi-task or domain pretraining incurs internal benchmark cost vs external gain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domain-pretrained initialization advantage
rubrics_metrics.description: Domain-pretrained initialization provides consistent advantages across task families.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initialize models with domain-specific pretraining (patent text) where possible, as this yields consistent improvements across retrieval, classification, paraphrase, and clustering tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public release and reproducibility
rubrics_metrics.description: All resources will be made available at this URL (authors commit to releasing code/data/models).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To support reproducibility and community adoption, release datasets, code, model checkpoints, and evaluation scripts; document data splits, negative mining procedures, and training recipes.
